import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)

  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })

addBox({x,z,w,h,d,color,y,rot=0,collide=true,ray=true,cast=true,receive=true, material}) {
  const base = y !== undefined ? y : this.heightAt(x,z);
  const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d), material);
  mesh.position.set(x, base+h/2, z);
  mesh.rotation.y=rot;
  mesh.castShadow=...; mesh.receiveShadow=true;
  scene.add(mesh); if(ray) this.raycastTargets.push(mesh);
  if(collide) {
    const c=Math.abs(Math.cos(rot)), s=Math.abs(Math.sin(rot));
    const ew=(w*c+d*s)/2, ed=(w*s+d*c)/2;
    this.colliders.push({minX:x-ew,maxX:x+ew,minY:base,maxY:base+h,minZ:z-ed,maxZ:z+ed});
  }
  return mesh;
}
```

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D Free Fire–style open-world battle royale web game with lobby, 1 km² map, named POIs, loot, aiming, damage/health, and sensitivity settings.

## Requirements
- 3D open-world shooting game.
- Lobby with start/deploy option.
- BR rank progression.
- Map size 1 km.
- Locations: Factory, Peak, Clock Tower, Rim Ram Village, houses, rivers.
- Loot: AK47, AWM, UMP.
- Aim-down-sights.
- Damage display and total health 200 HP.
- Sensitivity setting that changes gameplay.
- Build now without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly at finish.
- Mobile/touch support expected by project conventions.

## Decisions
- Static web game using locally vendored Three.js `0.187.0`, no runtime CDN dependency.
- Procedural 1 km² island with 5 POIs, river, bridge, roads, 23 bots + player (24 total), shrinking storm circle, BR rank saved in localStorage.
- Local fonts downloaded: Bebas Neue and Rajdhani, with OFL license files.
- Separate modules for world, weapons, audio, UI, effects, player, bots, and game orchestration.
- Player starts with selected preferred weapon plus M1911; all three requested weapons spawn as loot.
- Health set to 200 HP, medkits heal 75, bot damage tuned but not yet browser-tested.
- Touch controls implemented via pointer events; desktop uses pointer lock plus free-look fallback.

## Work State
### Completed
- Vendored Three.js at `vendor/three.module.js`.
- Downloaded fonts and licenses under `fonts/`.
- Created full HTML UI structure in `index.html`.
- Created full responsive HUD/lobby/results/pause styling in `styles.css`.
- Implemented procedural world, terrain, river, bridge, POIs, roads, nature, colliders, minimap base, loot/bot spawn points in `js/world.js`.
- Implemented weapon definitions, stats, first-person models, loot models, ammo boxes, medkits in `js/weapons.js`.
- Implemented synthesized WebAudio in `js/audio.js`.
- Implemented rank system, lobby/HUD/minimap/results UI in `js/ui.js`.
- Implemented particles, tracers, sky, sun, clouds in `js/effects.js`.
- Implemented player movement, drop/parachute, camera, shooting, recoil, ADS, reload, healing, weapon pickup/swap in `js/player.js`.
- Implemented 23-bot AI, bot combat, health bars, death drops, killfeed in `js/bots.js`.
- Implemented most game orchestration in `js/game.js`: renderer/scene setup, loading, lobby camera, match start/cleanup, loot spawning/pickup, zone logic, HUD updates, pause/resume/quit/results, rank awards.
- Added `capture.sh`, `start.sh`, `startup.sh` already existed; no package.json created.

### Active
- `js/game.js` is incomplete: input binding methods and the bootstrap/export at the end still need to be written.
- No browser test or screenshot verification has been run yet.
- No syntax check / ESLint / runtime test has been performed on the new JS files.
- Mobile controls are referenced but their pointer-event bindings are not yet implemented in `js/game.js`.
- `js/main.js` does not exist yet and must import/boot `Game`.

### Blocked
- Cannot claim playable state until `js/game.js` input methods/bootstrap and `js/main.js` are finished.
- Browser verification requires starting the static server and checking the console for errors.

## Next Move
1. Finish `js/game.js` by appending `_bindInput()` and touch-control binding methods.
2. Add `js/main.js` importing `Game` and instantiating it.
3. Run `node --check` on all JS modules; fix syntax errors.
4. Start server (use `PORT=3002 ./start.sh` in tmux or equivalent) and test with Playwright/Chromium.
5. Inspect console, lobby screenshot, deploy/in-game screenshot, shooting/loot/health/rank flows, and mobile viewport.
6. Fix gameplay/visual bugs found.
7. Add README note with assumptions and controls if appropriate.
8. Commit changes if requested by workflow.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: main game class; incomplete input/boot sections.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/main.js`: missing bootstrap entry point.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/player.js`: player movement, shooting, camera, ADS, health.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/bots.js`: bot AI/combat/loot drops.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/world.js`: terrain, POIs, colliders, spawns, minimap.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ui.js`: rank/HUD/minimap/results/lobby UI.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/weapons.js`: weapon stats/models/loot meshes.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/effects.js`: particles/tracers/sky.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: synthesized sound engine.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three.module.js`: local Three.js dependency.

- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/capture.sh`: screenshot/capture launcher.

  - `this.spawnLootAt(x,z,type,weaponId,delay)` and `this.hitBot(bot,damage,head,point,weaponName)`.
- `UI` has callbacks registered via `ui.on(...)`; `UI` constructor already binds deploy, weapon cards, pause/resume/quit, results buttons, settings sliders, lobby settings toggle.

- `start.sh` requires `RUNTIME_DIR`; environment has `RUNTIME_DIR=/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-runtime`.
- Use `playwright-cli` for verification and inspect screenshots; reject blank/loading screens.
